dog.description_text: Meet the hound mix pups who are eager to grow into their ears and paws! Autumn, Chestnut and Praline are proud, very playful and spunky 3 month old puppies who are eager to find their homes! They are vetted and spayed/neutered and arrivef from the shelter into their foster home on October 10th. They are decompressing and opening up while we learn a bit more about their personalities!
dog.name: Praline
